rationaleAppend: Isaiah 17:7-8: the participle ʿōśēhû 'their Maker' (as 'your Maker' at Isa 54:5) is followed in 17:8 by the same verb for human manufacture, maʿăśēh yāḏāyw 'the work of their hands' and ʾăšer ʿāśû ʾeṣbᵉʿōṯāyw 'what their fingers have made'. The English keeps 'make / Maker / work' across both verses, so that the contrast the prophet draws between the Maker and the made cult objects can be seen.
